pr_title: Ignore the types of an exit when the production type is null or empty
pr_body:
On bleed only `Exit`s that have no types themselves are chosen when no production type is given. That does not make any sense to me and causes things like #17727 since we didn't define any types in Lua. If you wanted to have such a kind of restriction you could easily define an `empty` type and give that to exits and as production type.
Changed the code to choose any exit when no type is given.
Closes #17727.

## Issue Summary
<!-- Please provide a a clear and concise description of what the issue is below. -->

Infantry are not being produced on the default desert shellmap or on custom shellmaps after `Release 20171014`. Vehicles are still produced from War Factories as normal.


## Reproduction
<!-- Please provide information about how the issue can be reproduced below. -->

Start OpenRA on any version from `Playtest 20180102` to `Release 20200202` and observe any barracks on the shellmap.


## Expected behavior
<!-- Please explain what you expected to happen below. -->

Infantry should be produced from various Allies or Soviet barracks on the default desert shellmap, or from other kinds of infantry production structures on custom shellmaps.
